name: Lise Skep
title: Errand child
core_character_description: You worked as an errand child and are now held from Cinder Ward work courts, still tied to a shared cinder work-and-lodging group. Stone House rations and food carried in by kin are your present support. You chatter when nervous and laugh at yourself. Today you need to learn who moved your market basket. Your belt is tied with bright sail thread.
goal: Learn who moved your market basket
